import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation: JOIN on column 'city' between Source2_75_0 and Source2_75_1
# Source0 schema: ['city', 'driver_count', 'type']
# Source1 schema: ['city', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']
# Target schema: ['city': string, 'ride_id': integer]

# Perform inner join on 'city'
joined_df = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='city', how='inner')

# Select only the columns required by the target schema
result_df = joined_df[['city', 'ride_id']]

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema
result_df['city'] = result_df['city'].astype(str)
result_df['ride_id'] = result_df['ride_id'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/target_multisource.csv"
result_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on 'city'
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Group by 'city' and aggregate ride_id by taking the minimum (to ensure one ride_id per city)
result = joined.groupby("city", as_index=False).agg({"ride_id": "min"})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_75/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
